summary: Practise taxonomy classification, evidence logging and review workflows for lending and investment. Explore the course and assess fit for your team.
lede: Green finance taxonomy training shows lending, investment and sustainability professionals how to apply activity criteria to financing decisions. Participants practise screening cases, checking evidence and documenting classification rationales, assumptions and exceptions. They also create review trackers and map taxonomy checks into credit and investment workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle lending, investment or sustainability evidence and need to turn taxonomy criteria into a traceable decision record.
prerequisites: Prior experience in lending, credit analysis, investment review, sustainability or financial risk is expected. You should be familiar with the basic stages of a credit or investment decision. No coding or programming is required; exercises use Excel for simple tracking.
